instruction: Open 'character.png' in GIMP and flip the image horizontally. Save the flipped image as 'character_flipped_h.png' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires flipping a 1280x1280 image horizontally in GIMP. Dimensions remain unchanged after flip. Evaluator verifies the output file exists with correct dimensions (flip operation doesn't change size).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if file exists with correct dimensions, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator cannot verify the core requirement (horizontal flip) - only checks file exists with correct dimensions
Getter extracts image hash but metric never uses it for verification
Logic will produce false positives - accepts any 1280x1280 image regardless of whether it was flipped
Missing comparison logic between original and flipped images to verify horizontal flip transformation
Metric comment explicitly admits it 'can't verify flip without original image', indicating known limitation
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to load both original (character.png) and output (character_flipped_h.png) images for comparison
Add logic to verify horizontal flip by comparing pixel values: output[x,y] should equal original[width-1-x, y]
Alternatively, compute perceptual hash of horizontally-flipped original and compare to output hash
Remove the misleading hash extraction if not using it for verification, or use it to verify image was modified from original
